scope: Synthetic in-memory VEX application only; excludes parsing, crypto, container operations and CI scheduling.
method: Three paired runs per size, median process CPU time. Reverse statement order. Same attestation checks, findings and fingerprint cache in both paths; reference substitutes previous list.remove algorithm. Output order and violations asserted equal.
note: Wall-clock measurements showed substantial scheduling variance; process CPU time is recorded to isolate this computation. No end-to-end or CI speedup is claimed.
